items.question: Is it mandatory to show the security audit report to get the production keys?
items.answer: Yes, all ecosystem partners need to be compliant to the NHA Information Security Policy for external ecosystem.

items.question: How to integrate digital health solutions in the sandbox?
items.answer: You can integrate your digital health solution in the Sandbox by making an online application here . It takes around 10 minutes to apply for this. The applications are processed in a maximum of 5 working days.

items.question: What are the tests required to be passed before exiting the ABDM Sandbox and before entering the production environment?
items.answer: Applications are required to undergo functional testing and security assessment before entering the production environment

items.question: What should I do if I have some technical query for my integration?
items.answer: Raise your concern on the dev forum here and clearly mention your client id on the thread. You may also refer to  for any further technical-related FAQs. Integrating entities can also reach out to the ABDM team for guidance on integration.support@nha.gov.in.

items.question: What is ABDM Sandbox?
items.answer: ABDM Sandbox is a digital space which is detached or separated from the actual digital health ecosystem. It is a space for experiment of integration before the digital health product is made live for the actual use. The integration for any health solution which intends to work in the ABDM ecosystem is first done in the sandbox environment. This is necessary to test the robustness, security function, etc. of the integrating ecosystem for various parameters before they are formally integrated into the ecosystem. Once these tests are done, access to the production environment of ABDM system is provided to the integrating entity. This step has been introduced to ensure that the health solutions are first tested in this contained environment before they are made available to participants in the live ABDM eco-system.

items.question: How do I participate in ABDM Sandbox?
Who can participate in the ABDM Sandbox?
items.answer:
Digital health solution providers or developers of any type can participate in the ABDM Sandbox and integrate its solution with ABDM. There are certain criteria to be fulfilled :
a. It should either be a company/ proprietorship firm/ LLP/ firm/ Partnership Firm/Proprietorship Firm/Trust/Society incorporated and registered in India or licensed to operate in India. Further, healthcare/health tech institutions constituted under a statute in India would also be eligible.
b. The entity must demonstrate arrangements to ensure compliance with the existing regulations/laws on consumer data and privacy for the time being in force.
c. There should be adequate safeguards built in its IT systems to ensure that it is protected against unauthorized access, alteration, destruction, disclosure or dissemination of records and data.
d. The test scenarios and expected outcomes of the ABDM Sandbox experimentation should be clearly defined, and the sandbox entity should report to the Mission on the test progress, based on proposed schedule. For more details, please refer to ABDM Sandbox Guidelines here
.

items.question: How do I check my integration? Do I get access to the reference applications to test my flow?
items.answer: The access credentials for EMRSBX is listed in Sandbox documentation. EMRSBX is a reference app that acts as HIP and allows integrating entities to generate records and link them with ABHA addresses. Access to the HIU reference app can be requested on the email address Here

items.question: What to do when my integration is completed? What are the next steps?
items.answer:
The steps for the exit process are detailed on webpage,
Following are the steps required to be implemented by an integrating entity after they have completed integrating their solution on Sandbox:
(i) Demonstrate implemented ABDM functionalities to the ABDM integration team
(ii) Post successful completion, completion of functional testing and security audit by NHA-impaneled agencies
(iii) Submission of ‘Exit form’ on Sandbox uploading all the required documents (functional testing report & certification; Security audit report; signed Undertaking document; and any other supporting document).
(iv) Post completion of all the listed steps, the ABDM team will proceed to schedule a demo for HTC (Health Tech Committee) members

items.question: Is it mandatory to get the functional testing done?
items.answer: Yes, as per the ABDM guidelines, all integrating entities must undergo testing of the implemented ABDM functionalities. Submission of the functional testing report and certificate is a mandatory step for participation in the ABDM eco-system.

items.question: Are there any terms and conditions for joining the sandbox?
items.answer: Yes, there are certain terms and conditions for joining the sandbox. These have been drafted to ensure privacy, security and confidentiality of the data and also create a level playing field. The details are available in ABDM Sandbox Guidelines .

items.question: Is any support provided to the integrators or applicants in the sandbox?
items.answer:
Yes. ABDM team extends support for understanding the integration flow and API sequence. ABDM team also helps with resolution in case the integrating entity encounters error during integration of APIs. Further, support is provided by following ways:
(i) Webinars & open-house sessions on integration steps and flow. Details of all the upcoming sessions are available on webpage Here.Recordings several sessions are uploaded on the webpage here .
(ii) One-to-one virtual connects with integrating entities for providing resolution to the technical concerns raised.
(iii) Documentation for integration is made available on webpage here.

items.question: Is there any reference documentation for other languages apart from Java?
items.answer: No, currently the implementation has been done in Java only. You can connect with other integrators who have completed integration in Python and PHP over the community. Such questions should be re-directed to the dev forum. There are some reference contributed by ABDM partners which has been made available at given webpage which has sample integrations with NodeJS, Python, PHP, etc. Click here

items.question: What are Application Programming Interfaces or APIs?
items.answer: Various software solution or digital solutions developed by various players are developed by using various software languages, standards etc. In simple terms, an API (Application Programming Interface) can be thought of as a messenger or mediator that allows different software applications to communicate and interact with each other. It is a set of protocols that allows solutions to understand and work with each other’s functionalities without needing to understand the underlying code. APIs allow different software applications, services, or systems to work together, share data, and perform tasks seamlessly thus enabling integration between different technologies. The ABDM/NHA has published APIs for ABDM functionalities on its website.Developers of various digital health solutions can consume ABDM’s APIs to get their systems integrated with the ABDM platform.

items.question: Are citizens, healthcare professionals or healthcare facilities required to register on sandbox?
items.answer: No. ABDM Sandbox has been set up for companies or entities working in the health space and wanting to integrate to become a part of the ABDM ecosystem. For example, health tech companies, vendors of Health Management Information Systems, etc. In case the digital solution used by healthcare professional or healthcare facility is not integrated with ABDM, they can request for their digital health solution provider to initiate the integration with ABDM.

items.question: What should I do if my technical query cannot be solved through dev forum?
items.answer: We suggest posting queries on the forum so the community can come forward and help. However, if your query is not resolved, you can call on the call center number, 1800-11-4477 / 14477 or file an online grievance here  You may also write to the ABDM team on integration.support@nha.gov.in.
